title: Honky-tonk piano contests, Red Cayou, Tatum, Kid Clayton and Tillman bands
summary: One long block: Tuts names the older and rival New Orleans pianists (Leon Mumfrey, Lester Lewis, Tink Baptiste, Red Cayou), how piano 'bucking' won him his name, the Celestin band, his idol Tatum, Stormy Weather, and his bands under Kid Clayton and Wilbur Tillman.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene
